text:
alex: FYI — onboarding sample app (python + go examples) has a bad retry pattern: Go example auto-retries on 401 and 403, causing token refresh storms. Repro snippet below.

mira: Can you paste the snippet? is it the sdk.SendWithRetry helper or something in the sample app wrapper?

alex: yep it's in sampleapp/go/client.go around SendWithRetry. tl;dr they treat any 4xx as transient. Code:```go
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if isTransient(resp.StatusCode) {
  return RetryWithBackoff()
}
```
Example response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` + body `{"error":"forbidden: api key lacks scope"}` — but the client retries and triggers token refresh flow repeatedly.

dylan: Oof. We intentionally map 401 -> AuthError (refresh token) and 403 -> PermissionDenied (don't refresh). Looks like go SDK maps both to RetryableError via isTransient(4xx). That's a parity bug with python.

sam: This actually explains the support tickets where customers see spike in token refresh calls and then rate limits. We should both fix the SDK mapping and the sample app README to show correct patterns (handle 401 specially, treat 403 as a hard failure). :facepalm:

alex: Also the README currently says "catch errors and retry" which is too vague. Proposal: add an idiomatic snippet showing: `if IsAuthError(err) { refreshToken(); retryOnce(); } else if IsRetryable(err) { retryWithBackoff(); } else { surfaceErrorToUser() }`

mira: +1. Concrete plan? I'll open a docs PR and attach the correct code. We should also add an explicit comment in the Go sample explaining why 403 is non-retryable.

ci-bot: CI: go-tests-sdk-retry-matrix failed — 3 failing tests in `retry_matrix_test.go` (auth vs permission mapping). See https://ci.example.com/builds/4823

dylan: I'll take the SDK fix. Plan: change Go SDK MapHTTPStatusToError to treat 401 -> AuthError(retry_hint: "refresh"), 403 -> PermissionError(retry_hint: "none"). Add unit tests for both. I'll also add an integration test that simulates stale tokens and permission errors.

qa-bot: Ticket RW-3421 created: "Go SDK: fix 4xx -> error mapping and update onboarding sample app". Assigning to dylan, adding test matrix for 401/403/429.

sam: For long-term ergonomics, let's standardize the error shape across SDKs: fields: `code`, `message`, `http_status`, `retry_hint` (enum: none, idempotent, refresh, backoff), `recovery_hint` (human text). That lets client code pick behavior without brittle string matching.

alex: Agreed. Also update sample app README to include a short policy for POSTs: include idempotency-key header and only retry on idempotent errors (429, 5xx) or explicit idempotent retry_hint. Include snippet:```http
POST /v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: 123e4567
```

mira: I'll add the doc PR with examples for python and go. I'll also add a one-liner in onboarding that says: "Do not auto-refresh on 403; check retry_hint."

dylan: FYI, will branch `fix/go-4xx-map` and open PR by EOD. I'll update CHANGELOG with breaking note for mapping changes (low risk).

qa-bot: After PR lands, CI will run `retry-matrix` and `sample-app-smoke`. Please link the sample app commit so docs can reference it.

sam: Thanks everyone. If we can get this out quickly it should reduce support load. :thumbsup:
